Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion, re-confirmed against the live GitHub-hosted documentation (fetched 2026-07-04): the Campayn API's ENTIRE documented surface is 6 endpoint-doc pages covering lists/contacts/forms/emails/reports/signup. Every documented GET (list/detail) endpoint is now a stream; every documented, dialect-expressible mutation (unsubscribe, add contact, update contact) is now a writes.json action. The upstream README's own 'Writing through the API' and 'Dealing with failure' sections are literally marked 'TODO' by Campayn itself (not a Pass B scoping choice) - the only mutations that exist at all in the published docs are the 3 implemented here. 'Signup' (POST /signup, creating a brand-new Campayn ACCOUNT/tenant, not a data record) is explicitly documented as a privileged, separately-authorized call ('you are not authorized to use the signup API function' is the docs' own 'most likely error' example) and is excluded as requires_elevated_scope.
